title: Figure 21: phase change material heat storage module for directed-energy lasers
description: Photograph of a flat rectangular metal plate module with copper-coloured edges held between two threaded rods on a grey background. Captioned "Figure 21. Phase Change Materials Allow Storage of Large Intermittent Heat Loads While Slow Regeneration Removes Heat from Aircraft (courtesy of P. Saunders, AFRL/RDS, Kirtland AFB, NM)." The text discusses a 3 MJ thermal energy storage device for cooling directed-energy weapon systems, followed by the start of a section on high-power fiber lasers.
